architecture.heads: one Linear(64,1) per domain; explicit required domain ID
architecture.output_buffers: per-domain train-only mean and population SD; not learned, not calibration, no Phase 18B fit
architecture.routing: Route only to the observed domain head; no inferred domain, no cross-head loss, unknown domain fails
architecture.shared: Conv1d(4,64,k=5/7/9,padding=k//2), ReLU, MaxPool1d(2), AdaptiveAvgPool1d(1), concat(192), Linear(192,64), ReLU, Dropout(0.3)

batching.epoch: fixed optimizer-step budget, not one pass for single-domain arms
batching.fairness: same steps and total examples per CNN; D has half as many examples per individual domain; log steps/exposures/time
batching.optimizer_steps: one update per batch, both D losses accumulated first
batching.sampling: domain-local sorted IDs, NumPy PCG64 SeedSequence [run_seed,domain_index,epoch,cycle]; permute without replacement, cycle/re-permute on exhaustion, full batches

bridge_analysis.comparison: D head pair versus paired A/B single-domain predictions; report delta agreement and own-label fidelity; consensus alone cannot establish correctness
bridge_analysis.inference: descriptive per-seed values and ranges; no success gate, no cross-domain raw-error comparison, no additional fitting
bridge_analysis.population: 41 exact canonical pairs, evaluated after all checkpoints frozen
bridge_analysis.role: secondary diagnostic only; previously inspected in Phase 18A, not a pristine confirmatory test; no selection or calibration

policy.hypothesis: A shared sequence encoder can improve sequence-linked SpCas9 indel-activity prediction while separate heads retain each assay's measurement mapping; benefit must not meaningfully harm either domain.

label.interpretation: Raw fraction A and raw percent B remain separate endpoints; affine output is algebraically equivalent to domain-local target standardization, not harmonization

loss.degenerate_policy: stop if SD is nonfinite or <= 1e-12 native units
loss.name: train_variance_normalized_raw_mse

metrics.seed_aggregation: arithmetic mean of per-seed metrics, not ensemble predictions
metrics.undefined: UNSTABLE_RESULT; no silent zero correlation or dropped seed

outcomes.benefit: both domains rho CI lower >= -0.01 and RMSE gain CI lower >= -0.02; at least one domain mean delta rho >= 0.01 with CI lower > 0; in both domains >=4/5 seeds preserve both margins
outcomes.negative_transfer: any domain rho CI upper < -0.01 OR relative RMSE gain CI upper < -0.02; directional harm flags also reported even when CI is inconclusive
outcomes.no_clear_benefit: all remaining valid, stable outcomes, including preservation alone or inconclusive harm
outcomes.threshold_basis: prospective project practical tolerances, not assay-derived biological cutoffs; no external-data basis
outcomes.unstable: missing/nonfinite seed or metric or invalid CI/bootstrap; any domain delta-rho range >=0.10 or RMSE-gain range >=0.20

split.B_eligibility: accepted10592 geometry-valid rows; no additional homopolymer filter; 10544 nonoverlapping development rows
split.bridge: hold all raw48 spacer groups; canonical41 paired diagnostics; remaining7 B-only quarantine; all group relatives held out
split.old_canonical_split: historical only; all Phase 18C baselines refitted from scratch on new experimental train partitions

statistics.invalid_replicate: no replacement draws; any undefined primary replicate -> UNSTABLE_RESULT and report count
statistics.limitations: single fixed split, five seeds, approximate hierarchical bootstrap, not a prospective power guarantee or gene holdout
statistics.multiplicity: Bonferroni four endpoints: rho and relative RMSE gain in each domain; familywise nominal 95%
statistics.resampling: each replicate: draw 5 paired seed indices, then sorted test spacer groups with replacement separately A then B; retain all rows of each drawn group and use same draw for both arms and all seeds; recompute metrics per seed, then mean the paired deltas; percentile CI, linear quantiles
statistics.secondary: 95% descriptive paired CIs; no additional confirmatory claims

stops: nondeterministic preprocessing or split fingerprint mismatch

training.checkpoint: lowest unrounded validation objective, earliest tie; patience reset only when loss < significant_best-0.0001; significant_best updated only on reset; evaluate each epoch
training.determinism: CPU float32 model, four threads, deterministic algorithms, Python/NumPy/Torch seeded, num_workers=0; log versions
training.initialization: fresh PyTorch default Conv/Linear initialization; encoder RNG=run_seed; independent head RNG=run_seed+1000+domain_index; paired across arms
training.validation_metric: same domain-normalized MSE objective as training; D equal-domain mean; whole validation partitions
